ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Extent of Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the amount of money stolen and the individuals or organizations involved
questions: How much money has been stolen from the Medicaid program in Minnesota?
Who is responsible for the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and hold those responsible accountable. By following the money, we can determine the extent of the fraud and identify potential suspects.
